filament_notes:
SUNLU Easy PA - special "easy print" nylon formulation, reduced warping/moisture-sensitivity vs standard PA, high strength/toughness. Datasheet: nozzle 250-280C, bed 30-50C, retraction 0.8-1.2mm @ 30-40mm/s, print speed 70-160mm/s, cooling fan OFF, PEI textured plate + glue, dry 4-6h @ 80-110C.

U1-specific tuning (chamber heater, max 60C, passive cover):
- Chamber held at 60C (activate_chamber_temp_control + chamber_temperature), the printer's max via Panda Breath, to slow the cooling gradient through PA's crystallization/shrinkage window - this is the primary warp-reduction lever available beyond the filament's own formulation. chamber_minimal_temperature 55C so M191 doesn't stall waiting to fully saturate before starting.
- Fan forced to 0 (fan_max_speed/fan_min_speed) per Sunlu's "cooling fan off" spec - matches the strength/warp priority since uneven surface cooling is what drives nylon's warp and delamination. Overhang/bridge fan assist kept on at a modest 30% (enable_overhang_bridge_fan + overhang_fan_speed) purely to prevent overhang sag; reduce_fan_stop_start_freq 0 so it can spin fully back down between overhang zones instead of idling. close_fan_the_first_x_layers extended to 5 to protect first-layer bed adhesion at these below-typical-PA bed temps.
- Bed 45C steady / 50C initial layer (top of Sunlu's 30-50C range) - low vs. generic PA (which usually wants 90-100C) because Easy PA's formulation is tuned to not need it; the 60C chamber does the warp-control work instead. IMPORTANT: bed prep is GLUE (PVA-type glue stick, e.g. Magigoo/Elmer's) on the PEI textured plate, not bare-plate adhesion - nylon does not reliably stick to bare PEI.
- Nozzle 265C steady / 270C initial layer - upper-middle of the 250-280C range, biased hot for stronger interlayer fusion (this build's stated priority is strength) while leaving headroom below 280C to limit stringing/ooze given nylon's hygroscopic tendency to spit/pop when even slightly damp.
- filament_retraction_length 1.0mm @ 35mm/s - mid-range of datasheet's 0.8-1.2mm / 30-40mm/s.
- filament_max_volumetric_speed raised to 10mm3/s (from the generic-PA default of 8) to reflect Sunlu's claimed "good flowability" - revisit downward if you see under-extrusion or nozzle-pressure artifacts.

Drying is not optional: dry 4-6h @ 80-110C before every spool, and consider printing straight from a dry box - PA absorbs moisture fast enough mid-print to cause popping/weak layers even from an otherwise-dry spool. Keep the print area/cover free of dust (per Sunlu) - the U1's passive top cover already limits ambient dust ingress during long PA prints, take advantage of it and keep it closed for the whole print, not just chamber heat-soak.

Not yet tuned: layer-height/wall/infill strength settings live in the process profile, not here - pair with the "AI 0.20 Draft/Strength Sunlu Easy PA @ .4" process tiers for wall count / infill density.

Cooling refinements (2026-08-12): support_material_interface_fan_speed 15% - the general layer fan stays at 0% everywhere else, but a little airflow specifically on the support interface layer (the surface that touches the part) helps it firm up faster for a cleaner witness surface without turning on cooling anywhere it would promote warp. ironing_fan_speed 20% - only engages when a process tier uses ironing_type (the Strength tier's top-surface seal pass); a mild fan there keeps the ironed top from staying glossy/soft-blobby in the 60C chamber. Both are independent of the main fan_min/max_speed=0 - Force cooling for overhangs and bridges (enable_overhang_bridge_fan) must stay ON for the 30%/15% overhang and internal-bridge fan values above to have any effect; if it shows as off in the app, that's a stray unsaved toggle, not this file - reload from disk.
name: AI Sunlu Easy PA @ NoCooling
